posts.text: Yesterday Pennar declared results, india revenue felt short by expectations but the main reason, i bought this stock is the under appreciated value of their US businesses Market is still assigning PE to pennar as legacy indian PEB player But very few are appropriately valuing their US businesses Now their US businesses is 100 million ARR (which was 40 million ARR couple of quarters ago) Servicable market size for Pennar in US is atleast 1 billion dollars opportunity They have barely scratched the surface there Watch out for this number, consolidation revenues are broadly in line image 1170×788…
